paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Critic model choices. Both follow the SIM-RAG setting with GPT-4 as the Reasoner, but the blue bar uses learned Flan-T5-783M as a Critic, while the red bar uses GPT-4 as the Critic (a.k.a., self-critique).
model_annotation: This bar chart presents an ablation study comparing the performance of two Critic models—Flan-T5-783M (blue bars) and GPT-4 (red bars)—within a SIM-RAG setting where GPT-4 serves as the Reasoner, across three different datasets: TriviaQA, HotPotQA, and 2Wiki, each evaluated under two metrics: EM (Exact Match) and F1. The horizontal axis lists the six evaluation conditions, ordered from left to right as TriviaQA (EM), HotPotQA (EM), 2Wiki (EM), TriviaQA (F1), HotPotQA (F1), and 2Wiki (F1). The vertical axis represents performance scores ranging from 25 to 85, with tick marks at intervals of 10, and the scale is linear. For each condition, two bars are displayed side-by-side: the blue bar represents the Flan-T5-783M Critic, and the red bar represents the GPT-4 Critic. In the TriviaQA (EM) condition, the blue bar reaches 77.3 and the red bar reaches 77.1. In the HotPotQA (EM) condition, the blue bar is at 37.0 and the red bar is at 31.9. In the 2Wiki (EM) condition, the blue bar is 44.5 and the red bar is 32.5. In the TriviaQA (F1) condition, the blue bar is 82.8 and the red bar is 83.8. In the HotPotQA (F1) condition, the blue bar is 49.7 and the red bar is 43.3. In the 2Wiki (F1) condition, the blue bar is 53.3 and the red bar is 38.1. The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in the order of the dataset and metric labels on the x-axis. There is no visual emphasis such as shading or outlining beyond the standard color coding for the two models.
